evals.expected_output: Says the skill is a stub. Checks for .agents/product-context.md. Asks only for missing outline items (what, who, done, out of scope, constraints). Does not invent a long discovery workshop.
assertions: States that the skill is a stub
Checks for an existing product-context file
Covers what, who, done, out of scope, and constraints
